shadows.name: chrome-lift
shadows.purpose: Menus and persistent panels above the bench.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions; never bounce or elastic.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Collapse dense toolbars and two-column control rows.

components.name: Graph Node Card
components.description: The signature drafting-table unit: a 15rem flat card with hairline border carrying one pipeline step.
components.css: .ds-node-card { width: 15rem; background: #ffffff; color: #1f2328; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-node-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(31,35,40,0.10); } .ds-node-kind { display: inline-block; background: #8250df; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-node-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-node-handle { font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #656d76; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single loud action on a surface; Primer blue, gently squared.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0969da; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0757ba; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0969da; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Kind Badge
components.description: Pill marker that names a graph kind; semantic hue, never interactive.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #ffffff; } .ds-badge-role { background: #8250df; } .ds-badge-repo { background: #1a7f37; }

components.name: Outcome Badge
components.description: Run-outcome marker: green success, red failure, amber blocked, gray no-work.
components.css: .ds-out { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #ffffff; } .ds-out-fail { background: #cf222e; } .ds-out-ok { background: #1a7f37; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Hairline-stroked field; blue border shift on focus, washed red on error.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #1f2328; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #8c959f; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #0969da; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(9,105,218,0.25); }

components.name: App Header
components.description: Hairline-separated bench header: title left, run metadata in mono right.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #d0d7de; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-header-title { font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1f2328; } .ds-header-meta { font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #656d76; }

components.name: Finding Banner
components.description: Inline validation/advisory finding: washed semantic background, no resting shadow.
components.html: pipeline.yaml: step 'review' has no incoming edge
components.css: .ds-finding { background: #ffebe9; color: #cf222e; border: 1px solid rgba(207,34,46,0.3); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Overflow Menu
components.description: Chrome-lift menu: the one ambient shadow permitted above the bench.
components.css: .ds-menu { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 0.625rem; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(31,35,40,0.08); padding: 6px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; min-width: 12rem; } .ds-menu-item { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; color: #1f2328; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: rgba(9,105,218,0.08); }

narrative.overview: Bureau Canvas treats pipelines as drawings under a lamp. The chrome is sheet-metal neutral — a GitHub Primer-derived light surface that any developer already knows how to read — so the graph itself carries all expression. Precision tools, not decoration: pill badges, mono identifiers, and color-coded kinds are the only personality. The system is deliberately indistinguishable from Primer; familiarity is the feature. Ambient shadow is allowed only on persistent chrome; resting content surfaces stay flat.
keyCharacteristics: Primer-native light palette with color-scheme: light dark declared
Color-coded graph semantics: every node kind and outcome owns a hue
Pill badges and mono IDs as the signature density markers

rules.name: The Hue-Has-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Saturated color is never ornamental: blue, purple, green, and amber each name a graph kind, outcome, or relation. If a hue carries no semantic, it does not ship.

rules.name: The Bench Gray Rule
rules.body: Anything contextual — work sources, terminal states, explanatory text — renders in Bench Gray, never a tinted variant.

rules.name: The One Loud Voice Rule
rules.body: Weight 700 is the only loud voice; it belongs to headlines, titles, and labels. Body text never bolds for emphasis — it restructures instead.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Drawings lie flat on the table. Shadows answer state (hover, selection, open menu) or chrome — never styling.

dos: Do reserve saturated hue for graph semantics: blue=assignment/data, purple=role/agent/observes, green=repo/success, amber=pipeline/decision/blocked.
Do keep spacing on the 0.25-1.5rem scale and corners at 0.625rem (6px for inner controls, 999px for badges).
Do render identifiers, hashes, and handles in 12px mono.
Do let ambient shadow appear only on chrome: menus, persistent panels, overlays.
donts: Don't use color decoratively — a hue without a semantic is a defect.
Don't add resting shadows to content cards; the bench is flat.
Don't introduce font weights outside 400/700, or display faces outside the system stack.
Don't wrap panels in nested cards; hairline borders divide, fills don't.
